newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq slips slightly, countering Dow's rally.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq slips slightly, countering Dow's rally.

text.p: Nasdaq shares eased slightly Tuesday, failing to hold on to gains seen during a late rally on Monday.

Nasdaq shares dropped 3.64 points or 0.30 percent to close unofficially at 1212.77. The session was mixed, with advancing issues beating decliners 2249 to 2030 on total volume of 584 million. The Nasdaq's decline countered a sharp rally in the Dow industrials, which gained about 135 points in one of the strongest point gains ever.
"There was some big tech names that pulled everything down today. Intel had some worries today, which set the tone. The techs failed to catch on to the rally in the Blue Chips," one trader said.

Intel Corp, late Monday, dropped after the world's biggest computer chip maker forecasted slowing revenue and falling gross margins in future quarters. Intel hit an intraday low of 128-4/16, but recovered slightly to close at 131, down 2-3/4.
Cisco Systems Inc fell 3-1/8 to 50-1/8 after Salomon Brothers trimmed its earnings estimates.
Shares of Avant! Corp lost almost half their value after felony charges were filed against the company and its officer for allegedly stealing a rival's technology.
